wargear.name: Cold-blooded Princeps
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A Princeps who has spent decades listening to the reactor's heartbeat and never once let it rattle him. The Titan's controlling player may re-roll one failed Power Hungry or Overload check each battle.

wargear.name: Fire-eater Princeps
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A Princeps who fights at the edge of the neural link and lets the engine run hot. Once per battle, at the start of the controlling player's Shooting Phase, the Titan may fire one weapon twice, but must then take a Power Hungry check with a -1 penalty.

wargear.name: Overlapping void arrays
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Secondary projectors are stitched into the primary lattice, so a collapsing shield is quickly replaced. The first time the Titan's void shields would be reduced to zero in a battle, restore one void shield immediately.

wargear.name: Servitor-hardened plates
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Hull plates seeded with banked servitor labour that can be called on to slap armour back over a breach. The vehicle gains +1 Hull Point.

rites.name: The Hunting Pack
rites.flavor: Where the great engines march, the Warhounds have already seen the enemy's backs.
benefits: Warhound Titans may fill Fast Attack slots and gain Vanguard (2).
Warhounds gain Pack Hunters: Outflank, and any Warhound that arrives from Reserves may Rush and still fire one weapon that turn.
limitations: At least two Warhounds are required.
No Reaver, Warbringer or Warlord Titans.
At least half of the Warhounds must start the battle in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Hunting Pack: Vanguard (2), Pack Hunters.

require.note: A pack needs at least two Warhounds.

rites.name: The Reactor Gambit
rites.flavor: The Princeps do not ask permission of the reactor. They tell it how long it has.
benefits: Every Titan gains Fast (1) and Overcharged Reactor: once per battle, in its Movement phase, it may add 6" to its Move and still fire all weapons.
limitations: At least two Titans are required.
No Titan keeps its Repair Crew, and a Titan that uses Overcharged Reactor loses 1 Hull Point.

modifiers.text: The Reactor Gambit: Fast (1), Overcharged Reactor.

require.note: The gambit needs at least two Titans.

rites.name: The Void-Wall Bastion
rites.flavor: A Titan is only as safe as the men who stand beneath its knees.
benefits: Secutarii Cohorts may fill Elites slots, gain a 4+ Invulnerable Save and Line (2).
Secutarii gain Void-Wall Guard: an enemy that declares a Charge against a friendly Titan must instead charge the nearest unit with this rule within 6" of that Titan, if it is in range.
limitations: At least two Secutarii Cohorts are required.
No more than one Titan, and no Warbringer or Warlord.

modifiers.text: The Void-Wall Bastion: best 4+ Invulnerable Save, Line (2), Void-Wall Guard.

require.note: Bring at least two Secutarii Cohorts.

rites.name: The Bonded Cybernetica Maniple
rites.flavor: The Princeps leads from the Titan's head. The Castellaxes lead from nowhere at all.
benefits: Castellax Battle, Castellax Destructor and Domitar Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Maniples gain Bonded Directive: while within 12" of a friendly Titan they automatically pass Morale and Cool Checks.

modifiers.text: The Bonded Cybernetica Maniple: Line (1), Bonded Directive.

require.note: A Titan must anchor the Maniples.

rules.name: Pack Hunters
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Hunting Pack). A model with this rule gains Outflank. On a turn it arrives from Reserves it may Rush and still fire one weapon at its full Ballistic Skill.

rules.name: Overcharged Reactor
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Reactor Gambit). Once per battle, in its Movement phase, a model with this rule may add 6" to its Move and still fire all its weapons that turn. It then loses 1 Hull Point with no save of any kind.

rules.name: Void-Wall Guard
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Void-Wall Bastion). When an enemy unit declares a Charge against a friendly Titan, and a unit with this rule is within 6" of that Titan and within the charger's reach, the charger must charge the nearest such unit instead.

rules.name: Bonded Directive
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Bonded Cybernetica Maniple). A unit with this rule within 12" of a friendly Titan automatically passes Morale and Cool Checks.
